name: github_search_code
description: This tool allows you to search for code across GitHub repositories using the code search syntax. Use this tool to locate where a symbol, string, or filename appears. Search scope can be restricted with qualifiers such as repo:, org:, path:, and language:. Note that code search only indexes the default branch of each repository and files smaller than 384 KB, so absence of a result is not proof the code does not exist.

query.description: The search keywords plus any qualifiers, e.g. octocat in:file extension:rb repo:octocat/hello-world.

pagination.title: Pagination options
pagination.description: Standard cursor-based pagination controls shared by every list endpoint in this server.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor returned in the previous page of results. Omit for the first page.

page_size.description: Number of items to return per page. The server clamps values above the maximum.
